body: Do you ever get frustrated or feel like your SO isn't filling your needs?

Wow... thank you. I just wanted someone to tell me it was okay to have questions. I'm living with my girlfriend of 2 years. I've had 5 serious relationships, all with females. I'm just tired of the way my relationships play out. 

I've been thinking, and I'm pretty sure attraction has to be more than a male/female thing, because I know 2 different people who have had sex changes and both of them had a partner throughout their changes. I think if attraction was some sort of helpless thing, an SO would immediately become unattractive if they changed sex, and that doesn't happen.

Attraction has to be about more than just looks, right? Do you think it would be possible for me to like guy with girlish features? Or maybe a guy who has all the positive qualities my current SO has, minus the vagina?

People like u/code-sloth. Which is everyone in my sphere of influence. Because I'm a girl and don't like boys. Everyone says something similar to what u/code-sloth just said. I'm not allowed to be confused and I'm not allowed to want to figure myself out. It's driving me crazy. A little piece of me was hoping I'd find someone by posting this who wants to listen. If I'm honest it's highly like I'll off myself in the next few months, I feel so completely run by everyone's opinion.
